title: Closing a Selling Account — Seller Performance Standing Conditions
content:
**Rule.** A seller may close the selling account voluntarily only while the record is in one of the voluntary-close allowed statuses; a suspended or under appeal seller must first have the suspension resolved. A deactivated record is closed by the system once the payments account has settled.

The status that decides this is the status of the seller's Seller Performance Standing record. A closure records the closing date on the record.

## Who closes, by status

| Status of the standing record | Voluntary closure by the seller | Closure by the system |
|---|---|---|
| good standing | allowed (a voluntary-close allowed status) | — |
| at risk | allowed (a voluntary-close allowed status) | — |
| suspended | not while suspended; the suspension must first be resolved | — |
| under appeal | not while under appeal; the suspension must first be resolved | — |
| deactivated | — | closed once the payments account has settled |
| closed | already closed | — |

## Points of reading

- "Only while" makes the allowed statuses a complete list: a record in any status not on it cannot be closed voluntarily.
- A deactivated record reaches closed through the system, not through the seller's request, and only once the payments account has settled.
